a.name: Tally box
a.description: Four litter figures in one hairline-ruled box on the counter bed, serif figure over a plain label; a 2x2 on phones.
a.differs_from: A box drawn in hairline rules with no fill or shadow, where built strips are plain, banded or carded and London's pick is a number line in an inset panel.

b.name: Range sheet
b.description: A white sheet of labelled cells, the six puppies' faces inline, and the delivery band drawn as a £200 to £350 range bar.
b.differs_from: The only strip with photos inline beside a figure and a range bar for the delivery band; built strips are photo-free tiles, and London's pick is a number line.

c.name: Stat block and rows
c.description: The six puppies set large on a steel block bled to the screen edge; prices and delivery follow as ruled price-list rows.
c.differs_from: One figure leads on a block that bleeds off the page edge and the rest are ruled rows; no built strip bleeds, and London's pick is an inset number line.
